harness_reported: Claude Code (Claude desktop app, Code tab)
omissions_note: All tool names and parameter names/required flags are listed. Long descriptions are truncated (marked [truncated]); MCP tool descriptions and parameter types/descriptions omitted (null/unknown) for length.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description: Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it. [truncated]

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: The task for the agent to perform

parameters.name: subagent_type
parameters.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional model override for this agent. [truncated]

parameters.name: isolation
parameters.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: AskUserQuestion
tools.description: Use this tool only when you are blocked on a decision that is genuinely the user's to make: one you cannot resolve from the request, the code, or sensible defaults. [truncated]

parameters.name: questions
parameters.description: Questions to ask the user (1-4 questions)

parameters.name: answers
parameters.description: User answers collected by the permission component

parameters.name: annotations
parameters.description: Optional per-question annotations from the user (e.g., notes on preview selections). Keyed by question text.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Optional metadata for tracking and analytics purposes. Not displayed to user.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description: Executes a bash command and returns its output. [truncated]

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. [truncated]

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

parameters.name: run_in_background
parameters.description: Set to true to run this command in the background.

parameters.name: dangerouslyDisableSandbox
parameters.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

parameters.name: allowed_domains
parameters.description: Hosts this sandboxed command needs to reach that the sandbox's network allowlist does not already cover [truncated]

tools.name: CronCreate
tools.description: Schedule a prompt to be enqueued at a future time. Use for both recurring schedules and one-shot reminders. [truncated]

parameters.name: cron
parameters.description: Standard 5-field cron expression in local time: "M H DoM Mon DoW" (e.g. "*/5 * * * *" = every 5 minutes, "30 14 28 2 *" = Feb 28 at 2:30pm local once).

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: The prompt to enqueue at each fire time.

parameters.name: recurring
parameters.description: true (default) = fire on every cron match until deleted or auto-expired after 30 days. false = fire once at the next match, then auto-delete. Use false for "remind me at X" one-shot requests with pinned minute/hour/dom/month.

parameters.name: durable
parameters.description: true = persist to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json and survive restarts [truncated]

tools.name: CronDelete
tools.description: Cancel a cron job previously scheduled with CronCreate. Removes it from .claude/scheduled_tasks.json (durable jobs) or the in-memory session store (session-only jobs).

tools.name: CronList
tools.description: List all cron jobs scheduled via CronCreate, both durable (.claude/scheduled_tasks.json) and session-only.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description: Performs exact string replacement in a file. [truncated]

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

parameters.name: new_string
parameters.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

parameters.name: replace_all
parameters.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: EnterPlanMode
tools.description: Use this tool proactively when you're about to start a non-trivial implementation task. [truncated]

tools.name: EnterWorktree
tools.description: Use this tool ONLY when explicitly instructed to work in a worktree [truncated]

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional name for a new worktree. [truncated]

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to an existing worktree to switch into instead of creating a new one. [truncated]

tools.name: ExitPlanMode
tools.description: Use this tool when you are in plan mode and have finished writing your plan to the plan file and are ready for user approval. [truncated]

tools.name: ExitWorktree
tools.description: Exit a worktree session created by EnterWorktree and return the session to the original working directory. [truncated]

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: "keep" leaves the worktree and branch on disk; "remove" deletes the worktree and, unless a hook made it or git refuses, its branch.

parameters.name: discard_changes
parameters.description: Required true when action is "remove" and the worktree has uncommitted files or unmerged commits. [truncated]

tools.name: ListAgents
tools.description: Lists agents you can SendMessage to [truncated]

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Not available in this build; leave unset.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The cursor the last line of a long listing gave, for its next page. Omit to list from the start.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Not available in this build; leave unset.

tools.name: Monitor
tools.description: Start a background monitor that streams events from a long-running script. [truncated]

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Short human-readable description of what you are monitoring (shown in notifications).

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Kill the monitor after this deadline. Default 300000ms. Deadlines above 1800000ms are capped to 1800000ms. You are notified at expiry and can re-arm.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Shell command or script. Each stdout line is an event; exit ends the watch.

parameters.name: ws
parameters.description: WebSocket to open. Each text frame is an event; binary frames are reported as a placeholder line. Socket close ends the watch. Cannot be combined with command.

parameters.name: allowed_domains
parameters.description: Hosts this sandboxed command needs to reach [truncated]

tools.name: NotebookEdit
tools.description: Replaces, inserts, or deletes a single cell in a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb file). [truncated]

parameters.name: notebook_path
parameters.description: The absolute path to the Jupyter notebook file to edit (must be absolute, not relative)

parameters.name: new_source
parameters.description: The new source for the cell

parameters.name: cell_id
parameters.description: The ID of the cell to edit. [truncated]

parameters.name: cell_type
parameters.description: The type of the cell (code or markdown). If not specified, it defaults to the current cell type. If using edit_mode=insert, this is required.

parameters.name: edit_mode
parameters.description: The type of edit to make (replace, insert, delete). Defaults to replace.

tools.name: Read
tools.description: Reads a file from the local filesystem. [truncated]

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The absolute path to the file to read

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

parameters.name: allow_large
parameters.description: Set to true to read a text file, or a line range of one, that is over the usual size limits [truncated]

tools.name: ReportFindings
tools.description: Report code-review findings as a typed list so the host UI can render them. [truncated]

parameters.name: findings
parameters.description: Verified findings, most-severe first; empty if none survived

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Effort level the review ran at

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description: Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode [truncated]

parameters.name: delaySeconds
parameters.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. [truncated]

parameters.name: stop
parameters.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent. [truncated]

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted [truncated]

parameters.name: notify_when_idle
parameters.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle [truncated]

parameters.name: skill
parameters.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: TaskStop
tools.description:
- Stops a running background task by its ID
- Takes a task_id parameter identifying the task to stop
- To stop an agent-team teammate, pass its agent ID or bare teammate name as task_id
- To stop a background agent spawned with a name, pass that name as task_id
- Returns a success or failure status
- Use this tool when you need to terminate a long-running task

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: The ID of the background task to stop. Agent-team teammates and named background agents are also accepted by agent ID or name.

tools.name: WebFetch
tools.description: Fetches a URL, converts the page to markdown, and answers `prompt` against it using a small fast model. [truncated]

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to fetch content from

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: The prompt to run on the fetched content

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Character position in the page text to start reading from. Use it to read on through a page too long for one call, with the value the previous result gave.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description: Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. [truncated]

parameters.name: scriptPath
parameters.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. [truncated]

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. [truncated]

parameters.name: resumeFromRunId
parameters.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. [truncated]

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

tools.name: Write
tools.description: Writes a file to the local filesystem, overwriting if one exists. [truncated]

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The absolute path to the file to write (must be absolute, not relative)

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The content to write to the file
